description: Manage the state of a program or group of programs managed by supervisord.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the supervisord program or group to manage. The name is taken as group name when it ends with a colon :. If name=all, all programs and program groups are managed.

parameters.name: server_url
parameters.description: URL on which supervisord server is listening.

parameters.name: signal
parameters.description: The signal to send to the program/group, when combined with the signalled state. Required when l(state=signalled).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of program/group. Choices: "present" "started" "stopped" "restarted" "absent" "signalled"

parameters.name: stop_before_removing
parameters.description: Use stop_before_removing=true to stop the program/group before removing it. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Manage the state of program to be in started state
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: my_app
    state: started

- name: Manage the state of program group to be in started state
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: 'my_apps:'
    state: started

- name: Restart my_app, reading supervisorctl configuration from a specified file
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: my_app
    state: restarted
    config: /var/opt/my_project/supervisord.conf

- name: Restart my_app, connecting to supervisord with credentials and server URL
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: my_app
    state: restarted
    username: test
    password: testpass
    server_url: http://localhost:9001

- name: Send a signal to my_app via supervisorctl
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: my_app
    state: signalled
    signal: USR1

- name: Restart all programs and program groups
  community.general.supervisorctl:
    name: all
    state: restarted
